mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION ( account_id, platform_id, platform_match_status, fingerprint, transaction_category, tran_date, tran_time, out_amount, in_amount, after_balance, desc1, desc2, desc3, desc4 ) VALUES
(#{tx.accountId}, #{tx.platformId}, #{tx.platformMatchStatus}, #{tx.fingerprint}, #{tx.transactionCategory}, #{tx.tranDate}, #{tx.tranTime}, #{tx.outAmount}, #{tx.inAmount}, #{tx.afterBalance}, #{tx.desc1}, #{tx.desc2}, #{tx.desc3}, #{tx.desc4})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform_id = COALESCE(VALUES(platform_id), platform_id), desc1 = COALESCE(VALUES(desc1), desc1)
mapper.select: SELECT account_transaction_id AS id, account_id AS accountId, platform_id AS platformId, platform_match_status AS platformMatchStatus, fingerprint, transaction_category AS transactionCategory, tran_date AS tranDate, tran_time AS tranTime, out_amount AS outAmount, in_amount AS inAmount, after_balance AS afterBalance, desc1, desc2, desc3, desc4, created_at AS createdAt FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tran_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY tran_date, tran_time, account_transaction_id

SELECT account_transaction_id AS id, account_id AS accountId, platform_id AS platformId, platform_match_status AS platformMatchStatus, transaction_category AS transactionCategory, in_amount AS inAmount, desc1, desc2, desc3, desc4 FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION WHERE platform_match_status = 'PENDING' AND transaction_category = 'ORDINARY' AND in_amount > 0 ORDER BY account_transaction_id
